title: 第23章 魔法婊第24章 魔法释放考核
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: “好了，别大声嚷嚷。考核现在开始，再有随意喧哗者直接取消资格！”秃顶考官虎躯一震，一切江湖恩仇消散。
“真想知道穆宁雪大小姐看着你在全校师生面前被魔法高中除名时脸上的表情，我想她一定会后悔，自己当初怎么会想要和这么一个废物私逃呢？”穆白也已经不需要再掩饰自己的目的了，在莫凡耳边阴险的低声说道。
“你口臭，我闻不了屎味，别离我太近。”莫凡用手那么一挡。
穆白嘴角一抽。
先给这小子嚣张一会！
当年，他当着穆宁雪的面把他摁在泥草里狂揍，让他穆白这一辈子都无法在穆宁雪面前抬起头来，耻辱至今。
今天，他穆白就要让这家伙死得更惨。
全校当众除名，还是当着穆宁雪的面，在这个魔法为尊的社会里，莫凡又要怎样被耻笑，又要被穆宁雪怎样看不起，等到他滚到他老爸莫家兴面前，又要怎么向连房子都卖了供他上魔法高中的老爸交代？
在年度考核中，一些不合格的学生被请离是很正常的事情。
请离并不会全校通报，学校不至于那么不人性化。
但有一种情况，学校会直接宣布请离，那就是魔法师的星尘几乎没有一点增长的！
正常情况下，学生觉醒了星尘后，每天坚持修炼再笨的人星尘也会慢慢光亮，魔能增长，除非这个学生真的是懒惰至极！
为了惩罚这种浪费了觉醒资源和魔法书的学生，为了让全校学生搞清楚，修炼不是儿戏，不是混日子的，学校会对修为过低的学生进行全校通报请离。
这种全校通报一届里面未必会有一个，学校设立就是为了鞭策那些后进生。
在这学期开学初，全班就进行过一个粗略检测，那个时候莫凡的修为几乎为零，薛木生一气之下差点想直接把这个名额内定给莫凡了。
这学期结束了，进入最庄重的年度考核。
不出意外，这个莫凡的修为非常接近全校通报请离的这条线。
当然，为了防止意外，穆白和他的叔叔穆贺可还准备了一份大礼给莫凡。
这份大礼，足以让莫凡稳定出线，荣获这份学校有三年没有开启过的惩罚。
很有幸的是，穆宁雪和穆卓云就在，也会将这一幕尽收眼底。
想到这些，穆白心情徒然大好。
今天即是表现自己，从此飞黄腾达的日子，又是莫凡贱人受苦受辱之日，畅快，畅快啊！
年度考核正式开始！
全校三十个班级同时进行。
测试过程其实非常简单，就是在众目睽睽，在考官的注视下将手放在星感石上，集中精神进入到冥修，这个时候星感石会根据测试的人星尘光辉强弱印射出一样的光芒，通过光芒来判断修为的高低。
每个学生都有三次的机会。
以光芒最强的那一次作为成绩。
当然，精神越集中的学生，感应石能够越真实的展现出学生的星尘强弱。
测试顺序是随机的，率先上去测试的正是那个靠前梨花带雨的何雨同学。
姑娘还是那么的怯弱，在大家的注视下步入到星感石面前的时候还非常扭捏，一副深怕自己会被除名的样子。
“可以开始了。”那位秃顶的考官说道。
“何雨同学，加油，老师和同学们都相信你。”班主任薛木生说道。
content_en:
"Okay, don't yell so loudly. The assessment starts now, and anyone who makes any random noise will be immediately disqualified!" The bald examiner shook his body, and all the grievances and grudges in the world disappeared.
"I really want to know the expression on Miss Mu Ningxue's face when she saw you being expelled from the Magic High School in front of all the teachers and students. I think she will definitely regret it. Why did she want to run away with such a loser in the first place?" Mu Bai no longer needed to hide his purpose and whispered sinisterly in Mo Fan's ear.
"You have bad breath. I can't smell shit. Don't get too close to me." Mo Fan blocked it with his hand.
Mu Bai's mouth twitched.
Let this kid be arrogant for a while first!
Back then, he pushed Mu Ningxue into the mud and beat him wildly in front of him, making Mu Bai unable to raise his head in front of Mu Ningxue for the rest of his life. He is still humiliated to this day.
Today, he, Mu Bai, was going to let this guy die even more miserably.
Expelled from the whole school in public, or in front of Mu Ningxue, in this society where magic is revered, how will Mo Fan be ridiculed, and how will he be looked down upon by Mu Ningxue? When he gets in front of his father, Mo Jiaxing, how will he explain to his father who even sold his house to support him in a magic high school?
In the annual assessment, it is normal for some unqualified students to be asked to leave.
The request to leave will not be notified to the whole school, so the school will not be so inhumane.
But there is one situation where the school will directly announce your departure, and that is when the magician’s stardust has barely increased at all!
Under normal circumstances, after a student awakens to Stardust, no matter how stupid he is if he persists in practicing every day, Stardust will gradually light up and his magic power will increase, unless the student is really extremely lazy!
In order to punish students who waste awakening resources and magic books, and to let all students in the school understand that cultivation is not a child's play or just messing around, the school will notify the whole school of students whose cultivation level is too low and ask them to leave.
This kind of notification to the whole school may not happen even once in a class. The school is established to encourage those underachieving students.
At the beginning of this semester, the whole class went through a rough test. At that time, Mo Fan's cultivation level was almost zero. Xue Musheng was so angry that he almost wanted to directly reserve this spot for Mo Fan.
This semester is over and we are entering the most solemn annual assessment.
Not surprisingly, this Mo Fan's cultivation level is very close to the line that the whole school should notify to leave.
Of course, in order to prevent accidents, Mu Bai and his uncle Mu Heke also prepared a big gift for Mo Fan.
This great gift is enough for Mo Fan to steadily qualify and receive this punishment, which the school has not opened for three years.
Fortunately, Mu Ningxue and Mu Zhuoyun are here and will have a panoramic view of this scene.
Thinking of this, Mu Bai was in a good mood.
Today is the day to express yourself and become famous, and it is also the day for bitch Mo Fan to suffer and be humiliated. Have fun, have fun!
…
The annual assessment officially begins!
Thirty classes in the school were held at the same time.
The test process is actually very simple. In front of everyone, under the gaze of the examiner, you put your hand on the Star Sense Stone and concentrate on meditation. At this time, the Star Sense Stone will emit the same light according to the intensity of the star dust of the person being tested, and the level of cultivation is judged by the light.
Each student has three chances.
Take the time with the strongest light as the result.
Of course, the more focused the student is, the more realistically the induction stone can show the student's stardust strength.
The order of the test was random, and the first person to go up for the test was He Yu, the student who was leaning against the pear blossoms and carrying the rain.
The girl was still so timid, and she was very shy when she walked in front of the Star Sense Stone under everyone's gaze, as if she was deeply afraid that she would be removed from the list.
"It's time to start." The bald examiner said.
"Classmate He Yu, come on, teachers and classmates believe in you." said class teacher Xue Musheng.
